newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [h2]Weapons Detail[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]22 Weapons available during the Beta.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Nine Weapon classes, from Assault Rifles to Melee Weapons.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Primary, Secondary, and Melee Weapon categories.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Unlock additional Weapons as you rank up.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Build every Loadout using Create a Class.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ad68585b2061f3a835a4daffe4f9d448c6c8e4aa.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]NOTE:[/b] This intel comes from the Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Everything You Need to Know Blog. [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/08/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-open-beta-everything-you-need-to-know"]Click here for the full blog[/url][/u].[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]During the Beta, you'll unlock and wield up to 22 of the 33 weapons available at launch, spanning every major weapon class. Whether you favor the adaptability of Assault Rifles, the aggressive mobility of SMGs, the stopping power of Shotguns and Sniper Rifles, or the utility of Launchers and Melee Weapons, the Beta offers a broad selection from the full Multiplayer arsenal.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Weapons are organized into Primary, Secondary, and Melee categories and can be tailored to your preferred combat role using [i]Modern Warfare 4's[/i] expanded Create a Class system. Throughout the Beta, experiment with different weapon classes, refine your loadouts, and discover which playstyle best suits every engagement.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Note: [/b]All Beta weapons except those only accessible via a Default Loadout, Launchers and the Combat Knife support the new Apex Attachment system, unlocking specialized modifications as you level up each weapon.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Here’s an at-a-glance confirmation of the weapons you can access during the Beta:[/p][list][*][p][b]Six Assault Rifles (ARs):[/b] Han 86, M4, Hyeon Burst, Kastov 762, Patriot XMR, Axion (Default Loadout only)*[/p][/*][*][p][b]Four Submachine Guns (SMGs):[/b] ISO Nightshade, PPSh-41, X-58 Nyx, Wz. 55 Striga (Campaign Mission only)*[/p][/*][*][p][b]One Shotgun: [/b]Rezi 12[/p][/*][*][p][b]Two Light Machine Guns (LMGs):[/b] FiNN LMG, Type 73[/p][/*][*][p][b]Two Marksman Rifles:[/b] MAR-9, Oris 8.6[/p][/*][*][p][b]Two Sniper Rifles:[/b] KG-7 Vulcan, Signal .50[/p][/*][*][p][b]Three Pistols:[/b] Krait P68, .50 GS, Sang 9mm (Default Loadout only)*[/p][/*][*][p][b]One Launcher:[/b] PILA[/p][/*][*][p][b]One Melee Weapon:[/b] Combat Knife[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]*Note: [/b]The Axion (AR) and Sang 9mm (Pistol) are available within a Default Loadout class you can choose at the beginning of your Player Progression. The Wz. 55 Striga is only available during the Campaign Mission. These weapons have no access to the Gunsmith or their Apex Attachment. All other weapons can be levelled up, and their Attachments and Apex Attachments unlocked.[/p][p align="start"][b] [/b][/p][p][i]The Firing Range[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Every Weapon category offers its own strengths, handling characteristics, and role within a Multiplayer match. As you unlock additional Weapons throughout the Beta, experiment with different loadouts and Attachment combinations to discover what best suits your preferred combat style. Visit the Firing Range at any time to compare Weapon builds, test Attachments, and evaluate performance before deploying into a match.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/797ecfefb65c96977aa10876dee37065b3635755.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]WEAPONS: TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]Beta test:[/i][/b][i] Try every weapon class early. Each class fills a distinct combat role, and unlocking multiple weapons expands your Create a Class options.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Hand-crafted support:[/i][/b][i] Use the default loadouts to sample the available arsenal. They let you try different weapon types while you’re still unlocking custom Create a Class options.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Good backup:[/i][/b][i] Don't overlook your Secondary Weapon. Swapping weapons is often faster than reloading during close engagements, making Pistols and Launchers valuable backup options.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Proven strategy:[/i][/b][i] Progress your favorite weapons. The more you level a weapon, the more customization options become available through Gunsmith and Apex Attachments.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Apex Attachments[/h2][p][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Unlock by fully leveling supported weapons.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Equipped separately from standard Gunsmith attachments.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Does not consume an attachment slot.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Introduce unique gameplay effects and weapon behaviors.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]One unique Apex Attachment is available for each supported weapon in the Beta.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Apex Attachments introduce a new tier of optional weapon customization, unlocked as the final reward for fully leveling a supported weapon. Equipped separately from standard Gunsmith attachments, they don't consume an attachment slot, allowing you to further specialize your favorite weapons without changing your existing build.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Rather than offering incremental stat adjustments, Apex Attachments fundamentally change how a weapon performs. Some transform familiar platforms into entirely new combat roles, while others introduce alternate fire modes, integrated equipment, or specialized tactical capabilities unavailable through standard Gunsmith customization. Every supported weapon has its own unique Apex Attachment, encouraging experimentation and rewarding players who master the arsenal.[/p][p][/p][p][b]APEX ATTACHMENTS: TOP TIPS[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]Every Apex Attachment is unique.[/i][/b][i] They don't provide generic stat bonuses; they introduce bespoke gameplay effects specific to each supported weapon.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]They don't consume an attachment slot.[/i][/b][i] Equip an Apex Attachment alongside your standard Gunsmith build to further specialize your weapon.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Choose your weapon first[/i][/b][i], then chase its Apex Attachment. Fully leveling a weapon unlocks its Apex Attachment, making weapon progression worthwhile beyond standard attachment unlocks.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h3]Primary Weapons Available During the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta[/h3][p][/p][h3]Assault Rifles Available in the Beta (6)[/h3][p][/p][p align="start"]Assault Rifles (ARs) offer a dependable balance of damage, accuracy, and handling, making them an excellent choice for almost any combat scenario. While they won't match the close-range speed of an SMG or the long-range precision of a Sniper Rifle, their versatility makes them one of the most adaptable Primary Weapon classes.[/p][p align="start"][b] [/b][/p][p][i]Han 86[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/653441b52c184948ed6264caa10b8ecf0670db27.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Immediately. [b]Levels:[/b] 68[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] Manufactured for the South Korean military, the Han 86 delivers reliable performance across a wide range of combat environments. Chambered in 5.56, the weapon’s high rate of fire and moderate damage make it a capable option for close-quarters engagements and longer-range fights.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: HAN 86 X20 SKYBREAKER: [/b]This advanced weapons system comes equipped with a specialized targeting optic and airburst launcher. The Han X20 Skybreaker dials into a precise area within range and fires a 20mm airburst shell, which detonates on target with devastating results. Highly effective at flushing cover.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]M4[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a35c257853cc623ff9c32356b0e6351101c75827.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank 9. [b]Levels: [/b]68[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel: [/b]Fully automatic and highly adaptable, this iconic service rifle excels in most combat engagements.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: M4 HURRICANE:[/b] A top-loading, high-capacity M4 variant chambered in 5.7x28mm. Taking inspiration from other bullpup designs, this agile right is light, maneuverable, and boasts a high rate of fire.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Hyeon Burst[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3605536ee5dd8e05a7da9618ad2cfca421ae90a9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank 18.[b] Levels: [/b]64[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel: [/b]A versatile North Korean prototype rifle running 6.8 SPC with a hard-hitting burst mode that puts fast, decisive rounds on target.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment 1: HYEON AUTO: [/b]Converted to fully automatic fire, the Hyeon Auto was built for laying down stable, rapid fire. Offering a substantial increase in continuous RPM over the burst fire/semi-automatic variant, this weapon relies on firepower over precision.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment 2: HYEON HYPERBURST:[/b] Features an overclocked receiver that delivers a blinding-fast, three-round burst followed by slow, controlled, fully automatic fire. Deliver a burst of precision followed by sustained fire to finish off anything still standing.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Kastov 762[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eff8169c566fd01b3d6e5af165e0107081653a5f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank 21.[b] Levels: [/b]71[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel: [/b]A full-auto 7.62x39mm rifle offering heavy per-shot impact with equally firm recoil. Reliable and forceful but requires control to keep on target.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment 1: Kastov 545:[/b] Fires 5.45x39mm rounds, offering smooth handling and rapid follow-up shots without sacrificing combat effectiveness.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment 2: Kastov ARC:[/b] An experimental disruption barrel with an integrated optic. Emits a concentrated high-intensity RF pulse capable of incapacitating infantry, crippling electronics, and destabilizing vehicles caught in its crosshairs.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Patriot XMR (Battle Rifle)[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6e3f57c1f894ab8dfcedeef5bd2efe91d7b8ccc9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank 25.[b] Levels: [/b]64[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel: [/b]A full-auto rifle delivering high-impact fire with substantial recoil, the Patriot XMR rewards controlled fire, hitting hard at mid to long ranges when properly braced.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment 1: PATRIOT XMR VOLT:[/b] Stun targets and clear tight quarters with shocking efficiency with this underbarrel launcher, which fires a wide dispersal of several 50,000V darts. Non-lethal, but powerful enough to override fine motor control and prime targets for elimination.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Axion[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/46562e427f7018fcc226a56c9988479691c2814f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Default Loadout Only.[b] Levels: [/b]67[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel: [/b]A moderate recoil .300 Blackout rifle with solid impact and a fast cyclic rate, built for controlled automatic fire.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment 1: AXION CRUSADER:[/b] Receiver conversion that reconfigures the R&M Axion into a compact, high-mobility variant with an integrated saw stock and side grip for aggressive maneuvering.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Submachine Guns Available in the Beta (4)[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Submachine Guns (SMGs) excel in fast-paced, close-quarters combat, pairing high mobility with rapid fire to overwhelm opponents before they can react. Their effectiveness drops off at longer ranges, rewarding Operators who can close the distance and stay on the move.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]ISO Nightshade[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5feef845aa10bd26be3502ed9aeb8d174ebdb273.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank Immediately.[b] Levels: [/b]56[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] A full-auto 9x19mm SMG with a fast-firing rhythm, the ISO Nightshade delivers strong class-level impact with a notable recoil signature.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: ISO TRACE: [/b]Specialized RFID ammunition tags targets on impact, feeding real-time tracking data to the optic’s integrated display, which shows a red dot of the target’s movement and direction.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]PPSh-41[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b228219cda7984c4018fe090d01769f4f0b28964.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank 11.[b] Levels: [/b]54[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] A legendary submachine gun with over 80 years of combat service, the PPSh-41 overwhelms enemies at close range with its best-in-class rate of fire and generous ammo capacity.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: PPSH-41 EMBER: [/b]A unique underbarrel that launches a rapid burst of advanced pyrotechnic projectiles, laying down intense incendiary coverage that remains burning for a short time, offering area control.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]X-58 Nyx[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ba5c6ef9738749127da40526a3da69d33c99f599.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank 27.[b] Levels: [/b]47[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] An integrally suppressed subsonic SMG with high impact, very low recoil, and a steady firing rhythm for effective stealthy operations.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: X-58 VOID: [/b]The pinnacle of stealth warfare. This subsonic modification produces an exceptionally quiet report, hides skulls on enemy deaths, and minimizes directional hit indicators to keep your attacks concealed.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]WZ.55 Striga[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f1865005f9034d01284df11779b221f74e98be52.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Campaign Mission Only.[b] Levels: [/b]52[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] Fast, lethal, and easy to handle, this 9x18mm SMG delivers best-in-class mobility and recoil control with significant stopping power and a slow rate of fire.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: \[CLASSIFIED][/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Shotgun Available in the Beta (1)[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Shotguns[/b] deliver devastating damage at close range, capable of ending a fight with a well-placed blast. Their limited effective range and slower follow-up shots mean success depends on closing the distance and choosing engagements carefully.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Rezi 12[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/36d7d072f6a5729faa6253e6e77991c7562735e4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank Immediately.[b] Levels: [/b]60[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] A fast-cycling semi-auto 12-guage, the Rezi 12 delivers powerful, controlled shots with smooth recovery. Built tough and tuned for decisive close-range work.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: REZI 12 ENFORCER: [/b]Enables pump-action cycling and is outfitted with a side-saddle for hot-loaded explosive slugs. The added capability extends the platform’s engagement envelope well beyond traditional 12-gauge roles.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Light Machine Guns Available in the Beta (2)[/i][/p][p align="start"][b]Light Machine Guns (LMGs)[/b] carry large magazines that let you stay in the fight longer before reloading, making them ideal for defending objectives and engaging multiple enemies. They trade mobility, handling speed, and quicker reloads for sustained firepower and ammunition capacity.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Finn LMG[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4283e7175e521e0cf5c99d56b28752fda3158e0e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank Immediately.[b] Levels: [/b]52[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] A high-impact 5.56x45mm LMG with a steady firing rhythm and a firm recoil feel, optimized for mobile sustained fire.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: FINN ADVERSE: [/b]A Tempus Armament weapon modification that unthrottles the rate of fire beyond the weapon’s operational abilities. Sustained fire can overheat the weapon, requiring the weapon to cool down before returning to full auto fire.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Type 73[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a829343ddb2026eeddb39031db039570ba79d763.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank 5.[b] Levels: [/b]57[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] A fast-cycling 7.62x54R LMG, the Type 73 offers balanced recoil and mid-tier impact for its class.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: TYPE 73 ASSAULT: [/b]A specialized weapon kit that adapts the Type 73 receiver to accept a top-mounted magazine loaded with Explosive Rounds. Limited ammo capacity is offset by the sheer, overwhelming stopping power.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Marksman Rifles Available in the Beta (2)[/i][/p][p align="start"][b]Marksman Rifles[/b] bridge the gap between Assault Rifles and Sniper Rifles, combining strong damage with accurate fire at longer distances. They perform best in the hands of Operators who can consistently land precise shots.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]MAR-9[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3de8fa4a42d59c2d529e748063e66d30ced645f8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank Immediately.[b] Levels: [/b]67[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] A designated marksman rifle chambered in 7.62 NATO, the MAR-9 delivers precise semi-automatic fire from a rigid, accurized platform. Its tuned gas system, heavy barrel, and optic-ready classis make it dependable for mid to long-range engagements.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: MAR-9 AUTO: [/b]Introducing the fully automatic Mar-9 Auto from Bruen. Boasting a high rate of fire, this powerhouse provides a significant increase in stopping power over its semi-automatic counterpart.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Oris 8.6[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6d9daea736a14fb75f56dd2452f546fd224d31a6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank 14.[b] Levels: [/b]68[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] A lightweight bolt-action rifle chambered in 8.6 Blackout, the Oris 8.6 delivers impressive energy from a compact, modular frame. Sleek monolithic design and smooth cycling make it effective for precision fire in tight or mobile engagements.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: ORIS 8.6 RAZOR: [/b]A compact blade module mounted to the receiver, housing a pair of rapidly deployable kunai for close-range, low-signature engagements. Designed as a reliable fallback when stealth or conservation of fire matters most.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Sniper Rifles Available in the Beta (2)[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Sniper Rifles are built for extreme-range precision, capable of eliminating enemies with a single well-placed shot. They trade mobility, handling speed, and faster follow-up shots for exceptional accuracy and stopping power.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]KG-7 Vulcan[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e2520dcd535678aad592f19e61d5c1e9fccfa9f8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank Immediately.[b] Levels: [/b]72[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] A high-capacity, bolt-action sniper rifle that has seen more combat than most. Its longstanding battlefield experience translates into a higher rate of fire for quickly sending shots down range.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: KG-9 DRILLCHARGE: [/b]Allows for KG-9 Drill charges to be side-mounted to the rifle. Each projectile drills into a surface before quickly detonating. Ideal for flushing out entrenched combatants.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Signal .50[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/95e200529f19dba26139e6bf00be236cdb715465.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank 30.[b] Levels: [/b]73[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] Equipped with a recoil-reducing reciprocating barrel, this devastating .50 Cal anti-material rifle offers enhanced shot stability and precision, helping operators stay on target when every round counts.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: SIGNAL 50 INFERNO: [/b]Gives “weapons hot” a new meaning. This aftermarket modification from XRK loads the Signal 50 with .50 Cal Incendiary Rounds, providing a significant increase to vehicle and Killstreak damage.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Available During the Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Secondary and Melee Weapons[/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Pistols Available in the Beta (3)[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Pistols provide a dependable backup when your Primary Weapon isn't the right tool for the engagement or needs to be reloaded. While they lack the range and firepower of Primary Weapons, their quick handling and fast weapon swap speed can prove invaluable in a firefight.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Karit P68[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f6c6b42d98251aea68dceaa6a14184966a34b62.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank Immediately.[b] Levels: [/b]34[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] A semi-automatic .45 ACP pistol with a modern, ergonomic frame, the Krait P68 delivers reliable performance and strong close-range effectiveness.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: KRAIT P68 COMMANDO: [/b]Held in an icepick grip, this CQB tactical knife is ready for action at a moment’s notice. Improves melee damage and melee lunge range. Off-hand stabilizes the weapon for better recoil control.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i].50 GS[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/03953812c481a2f9e492de815eedfe46a3bf7d55.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank 23.[b] Levels: [/b]50[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] A powerhouse in any operator’s hands, this 50-caliber sidearm is a heavy hitter when the recoil is controlled.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: GS MAGNA: [/b]Packing devastating firepower and a thunderous rate of fire, this fully automatic .50 GS turns every trigger pull into a show of force. Warning: Not intended for accuracy.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Sang 9mm[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d9eb416a3bec0a2762193ec4859a93287d9f4bd1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Default Loading Only.[b] Levels: [/b]34[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] A lightweight 9x19mm service pistol, the Sang 9mm offers quick cycling and easy handling, trading heavier impact for speed and controllability.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: SANG 9&12: [/b]An underbarrel single-shot 12-gauge chamber that adds a close-range breaching option to the Sang 9mm. One loaded round provides a decisive punch when the pistol needs immediate stopping power.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Launchers Available in the Beta (1)[/i][/p][p align="start"]Launchers specialize in destroying vehicles, equipment, and Killstreaks while remaining capable of dealing devastating explosive damage against groups of enemies. Their limited ammunition and slower reload times reward careful shot placement and target selection.[/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]PILA[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/222fc8f1eb78ef30aca8cd77468fab735f08573d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank Immediately.[b] Levels: [/b]36[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] A lightweight, portable air-defense system, the PILA can deploy both guided or unguided missiles as needed.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: None: [/b]No Gunsmith is available for this weapon.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Melee Weapons Available in the Beta (1)[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Melee Weapons are built for silent, close-quarters eliminations, rewarding Operators who can close the distance without being detected. They sacrifice ranged capability entirely in exchange for swift, decisive attacks at point-blank range.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Combat Knife[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/63f6aeb2f6795373754d718ea9b0b4f317321ee1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Unlocked: [/b]Player Rank Immediately.[b] Levels: [/b]30[/p][p align="start"][b]Intel:[/b] Lightweight combat blade with a reinforced spine and vented profile for fast, lethal use in close quarters.[/p][p align="start"][b]Apex Attachment: None: [/b]No Gunsmith is available for this weapon.[/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][p align="start"][b] [/b][/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h2]Gunny[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/aae3f7745c5866327404492b48b51c1e44f2d33b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Optional Gunnery Sergeant, nicknamed Gunny.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Weapon build recommender within Create a Class.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]With a click of a button, can generate new builds using the attachments you've already unlocked.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Adapts recommendations as your arsenal grows.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Built for both new and experienced players.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Short for Gunnery Sergeant, Gunny helps you spend less time building weapons and more time playing. Whether you're looking for a dependable all-round setup or experimenting with different combat roles, Gunny can quickly assemble effective weapon builds using the attachments you've already unlocked. All Gunny’s recommended weapon builds have been crafted by Infinity Ward’s developers.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Gunny serves two key purposes throughout the Beta. It provides ready-to-use weapon builds for players who want to jump straight into the action, while also helping you experiment with different weapon characteristics, engagement ranges, and playstyles as your arsenal expands. As you unlock additional attachments, Gunny's recommendations evolve alongside your Weapon progression, continually offering fresh ways to approach combat.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Gunny is entirely optional. Every recommended build can still be customized manually, giving you complete control over your loadouts whenever you want it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/215efef7d562f55e8cc39116905a4c3d519cc8fe.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]GUNNY: TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Try Gunny early.[/b] Generate a recommended build as soon as you unlock Create a Class to get into Multiplayer with a dependable weapon configuration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Experiment with different builds.[/b] As your arsenal grows, compare Gunny's Short Range, Balanced, and Long Range recommendations to discover which combat role best suits your playstyle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Make Gunny your starting point.[/b] Use a recommended build as-is or treat it as the foundation for your own Gunsmith customization as additional attachments become available.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][h2]Gunsmith[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5ca2d0f9fd574d5faf3981fb98cf125fef653941.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Customize Weapon performance, handling, and appearance.[/p][/*][*][p]Equip a wide range of Attachments to suit your playstyle.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock Apex Attachments by fully leveling supported Weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Compare Weapon performance using detailed Gunsmith statistics.[/p][/*][*][p]Build your own loadouts or use Gunny for optimized recommendations.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]Modern Warfare 4’s[/i] Beta features a robust Gunsmith, a deep Weapon customization system that lets you tailor a firearm's performance, handling, and appearance by equipping Attachments and, new to [i]Modern Warfare[/i], Apex Attachments to suit your preferred playstyle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9374b5f2c204a9348149970eae389400981f81e5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Returning players will already be familiar with Gunsmith, while newcomers can expect a broad range of Attachment categories that allow you to customize every aspect of your weapon:[/p][list][*][p][b]Optics:[/b] Improve target acquisition with a variety of sights, helping you line up shots more effectively.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lasers:[/b] Tighten hip-fire spread, support a Canted Stance, highlight enemies, and provide other close-quarters aiming benefits—though some lasers may reveal your position.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Barrels:[/b] Adjust a Weapon's damage range, bullet velocity, and other ballistic characteristics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Muzzles:[/b] Reduce recoil, suppress weapon fire, or otherwise refine shot control and weapon accuracy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Underbarrels:[/b] Enhance recoil control and aiming stability or equip specialized launcher attachments where available.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stocks:[/b] Boost mobility, accuracy, flinch resistance, or handling related handling traits.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rear Grips:[/b] Adjust weapon handling, including Aim Down Sight (ADS) and Sprint-to-Fire speeds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ammunition:[/b] Modify your weapon's rounds to alter ballistic performance, adding specialized effects or enhancing attributes like bullet velocity, damage range, or penetration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Magazines:[/b] Increase ammunition capacity or improve reload efficiency to keep you in the fight longer.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/43ad2039d970cf4a4842261226632875ad2e384a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Infinity Ward has introduced some streamlining to the way Attachments are accessed:[/p][list][*][p]Each Attachment is only unlocked once, meaning there is no redundant grinding. The same Attachment is available across all weapons that use it, once unlocked the first time.[/p][/*][*][p]Each weapon can unlock all attachments available to it.[/p][/*][*][p]Players do not have to utilize a different weapon to earn an attachment on their favorite gun(s).[/p][/*][*][p]Grow your arsenal: The more attachments you unlock, the more that become immediately available when you start to use a new weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Progression Speed: If you reach a level on a weapon that would award you an attachment you already own, you skip that level with a Bonus Level Up.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ce8d440cbe6fb49a25b6d010fd7c3cfec9b2a671.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]GUNSMITH: TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Start with a purpose.[/b] Build your weapon around the engagement distances and combat role you expect to face rather than trying to improve every stat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Use Toggle Details frequently.[/b] Compare detailed weapon statistics before equipping Attachments to understand exactly what changes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balance your build.[/b] Improving one attribute often comes with trade-offs elsewhere, so compare multiple builds before settling on a favorite.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Experiment with different Attachment categories.[/b] Small changes to optics, grips, ammunition, or stocks can dramatically alter how a weapon handles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Let Gunny do the heavy lifting if you're unsure.[/b] Generate an optimized build first, then fine-tune it manually as you unlock additional Attachments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Canted Stance:[/b] Unlock compatible Laser Attachments such as the 1mW and 5mW Canted Lasers to access Canted Stance. This greatly improves ADS responsiveness and tactical mobility, though your laser beam will remain visible while aiming.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hollow Point Ammunition:[/b] Returning for [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], Hollow Point rounds delay enemy healing and cause critically injured Operators to leave a blood trail, making wounded enemies easier to track down.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 [/i]development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on Steam on Friday, October 23, 2026.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 [/i]for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox for Steam.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]* Actual launch date(s), times, and platform availability of MP Beta subject to change. See [/i][url="https://www.callofduty.com/beta"]www.callofduty.com/beta[/url][i] for more details. Minimum Open Beta duration is 2 days. Limited time only. Internet connection required. Online multiplayer subscription may be required for MP Beta.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][p align="start"][i]©/TM/® 2026 Activision Publishing, Inc.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][p align="start"][i]For more information, please visit [/i][url="https://www.callofduty.com"]www.callofduty.com[/url][i] and [/i][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/callofduty"][/dynamiclink][i], and follow [u][url="https://twitter.com/activision"]@Activision[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://twitter.com/CallofDuty"]@CallofDuty[/url][/u] and [/i][u][url="https://x.com/InfinityWard"]@InfinityWard[/url][/u][i] on X, Instagram, and Facebook. For Call of Duty Updates, follow [u][url="https://twitter.com/CODUpdates"]@CODUpdates[/url][/u] on X.[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]Join [u][url="http://discord.gg/CallofdutyOfficial"]Call of Duty's Official Discord[/url][/u] to get the latest updates and maybe even meet your next squadmate![/i][/p]

newsitems.contents: [h2]Player Progression (Multiplayer)[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][i]Unlock new weapons, equipment, Perks, Field Upgrades, Killstreaks, and Beta Rewards by increasing your Player Level.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Weekend One: Progress through Level 30 to unlock every gameplay item and all eight Beta Rewards.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Unlocked Beta Rewards become available in the full game when Modern Warfare 4 launches on October 23.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/70b787eaa3d862763fe0dc86217b53de245bcac2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]NOTE:[/b] This intel comes from the Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Everything You Need to Know Blog. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090?emclan=103582791472023113&emgid=689766422328378558"]Click here[/url] for the full blog.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Every match you play earns XP toward your Player Level (also known as Player Rank), steadily unlocking new ways to customize your Operator both cosmetically and tactically. Early progression expands your selection of Default Loadouts before Create a Class unlocks at Level 4, opening access to fully customized loadouts. Continue ranking up to unlock additional weapons, Equipment, Perks, Field Upgrades, Killstreaks, and eight Beta Rewards throughout the Beta.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Track your Player Level and XP progress[/b] from the Multiplayer lobby and after every match via the After Action Report. Each new level immediately unlocks additional gameplay items, making it easy to see what's available next as you progress through the Beta.[/p][/*][*][p][b]For a complete overview[/b] of your progression, open the main Multiplayer left Side Menu, select Career Profile (top left), then choose Progression. Here you can view your current Player Level, Rank, upcoming unlocks, and every item earned throughout the Beta.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cc979c84eb150823e8fae38345efa810a4b94918.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Open Beta allows progression to Player Level 30, granting access to all Beta gameplay unlocks and Beta Rewards. Cosmetic Beta Rewards earned during the Beta are tied to your Activision Account and will be available when [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches, while gameplay progression resets when the Beta concludes.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]PLAYER PROGRESSION TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b][i]Unlock Create a Class immediately: [/i][/b][i]New players begin with Default Loadouts. Reach Player Level 4 as quickly as possible to unlock Create a Class and start building your own custom loadouts.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Check your Daily Challenges:[/i][/b][i] Review your available Daily Challenges before deploying. Many can be completed together, helping you earn bonus XP and progress through the Player Levels more quickly.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Keep an eye on your next unlock:[/i][/b][i] Use the Progression screen to see exactly what's coming next. Knowing your upcoming weapon, Perk, Equipment, or Killstreak unlock can help you plan your next matches.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Remember the weekend caps:[/i][/b][i] Weekend One is capped at Player Level 20. Return for Weekend Two to continue progressing through Level 30 and unlock the remaining gameplay items and Beta Rewards. You can continue to play once you’ve hit the Player Level cap, you will just not be able to level up any further than each weekend’s cap. Earning XP once you’ve hit the Player Level cap will not go toward the second weekend.[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][p][/p][h3]Player Level Unlocks[/h3][p align="start"]The complete Player Level progression for the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta is shown below.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Level 1-20 Unlocks[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/842b1efca4fe281b0feb58c9d3dd44634c3f2091.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Level 1 – Private I[/i][/p][list][*][p]Assault Default Loadout[/p][list][*][p]Kastov 762 Assault Rifle[/p][/*][*][p]Sang 9mm Pistol[/p][/*][*][p]Portable Radar Field Upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]Frag Grenade Lethal[/p][/*][*][p]Flash Grenade Tactical[/p][/*][*][p]Quick Fix Perk[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Stalker Default Loadout[/p][list][*][p]ISO Nightshade SMG[/p][/*][*][p]Krait P68 Pistol[/p][/*][*][p]Sticky Grenade Lethal[/p][/*][*][p]Smoke Grenade Tactical[/p][/*][*][p]DDoS Field Upgrade[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Breacher Default Loadout[/p][list][*][p]REZI 12 Shotgun[/p][/*][*][p].50 GS Pistol[/p][/*][*][p]Drill Charge Lethal[/p][/*][*][p]Snapshot Grenade Tactical[/p][/*][*][p]Smoke Wall Field Upgrade[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Level 2 — Private II[/i][/p][list][*][p]Demolition Default Loadout[/p][list][*][p]FINN LMG[/p][/*][*][p]PILA Launcher[/p][/*][*][p]Stim Tactical[/p][/*][*][p]Trip Wire Lethal[/p][/*][*][p]Riot Shield Field Upgrade[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p 7.62x54R LMG, the Type 73 offers balanced recoil and mid-tier impact for its class.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Level 6 — Private First Class I[/i][/p][list][*][p]Bomb Glider — Killstreak, 4 Kills, Hand-held glider with an explosive payload.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Level 7 — Private First Class II[/i][/p][list][*][p]Drill Charge Lethal — Equipment, Thermal newsitems.title: The International 2026 Grand Champions
newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/bab4343d906943ef2117ae553347d8f8991ebca3.png"][/img]Congratulations to Team Spirit, Grand Champions at The International 2026. After enduring a challenging year, Team Spirit regained their ultimate form just in time to take a five-game Grand Finals slugfest and claim the Aegis of Champions in Shanghai.[/p][p]Spirit's Group Stage started strong, with 2-0 victories over both Xtreme Gaming and Aurora Gaming. They followed with 2-1 win over Team Liquid that put Spirit just one series win away from qualifying for the main stage. They wouldn't get it. Instead, they served as a stepping stone. First to Team Vision, who dropped Spirit in just two games to secure their own invite to the arena. Next, Nigma Galaxy followed suit, handing Spirit another 0-2 loss to snatch a spot on the main stage and force Spirit into elimination play.[/p][p]Their elimination-round opponent? A scrappy Team Resilience who, despite their lower spot in the standings, had clawed out at least one victory in every series they'd played. This round would be no different. Team Spirit took game one with ease, but Resilience rebounded to force a win-or-go-home game three. There, Team Resilience managed to keep pace for a while, until Spirit pulled away in the back half of the match to secure their spot at The International Main Event.[/p][p]The first obstacle at the arena would be the dangerous Iron Wing -- who'd already taken Group Stage series wins off three teams who'd reached the main stage. It wouldn't matter. Team Spirit clipped Iron Wing to send them spiraling into the Lower Bracket and eventual elimination.[/p][p]The next series wouldn't net Spirit the same results. Team Vision, the foe that had already denied them an easy path to the Playoffs, was waiting for them once more. And the result was mostly the same -- Spirit lost. This time 1-2. This time falling into the Lower Bracket, where Team Liquid was already waiting after eliminating last year's champions. Liquid had a stellar showing in the groups, dropping only one series. But that loss came to this same Team Spirit squad they were again facing, and now Team Spirit wouldn't concede even one game.[/p][p]Spirit flushed Liquid out of the tournament to begin an undefeated run through the Lower Bracket, next bouncing both BoomBoys and Team Yandex with 2-0 statements to reach the Grand Finals against -- who else -- Team Vision, the front-runners that had been blocking Spirit's path every step of the way. The team that had stopped Spirit from skipping the elimination round. That had dropped them into the Lower Bracket to fight for their lives. The team that hadn't lost a single series in Shanghai... was now the one thing standing between Team Spirit and the Aegis of Champions.[/p][p]Game one was Team Spirit all the way. They looked to be cruising to victory in game two as well, but Vision had other plans, clawing back to even the series at one game apiece. It seemed that Vision might steal the momentum by snatching game three, but Spirit held firm to retake the series lead 2-1, just one win away from the Aegis. Once again, Vision would deny them. Their steady play in game four left no room for doubt -- this series was bound for a winner-take-all game five. And it didn't disappoint.[/p][p]After an hour-long showdown that was still anyone's game until the very end, Team Spirit finally overcame the team that had tormented them throughout the tournament, claiming the Aegis of Champions and crowning themselves the very best Dota team in the world. Three-time winners Yatoro and Collapse, and two-time winner Larl now welcome their teammates not_me and rue into an immortal pantheon.[/p][p]As bearers of the ultimate symbol of victory, these names shall forever be inscribed upon the Aegis of Champions:[/p][p][/p][p][b]2026 - Team Spirit[/b][/p][list][*][p]Illia "Yatoro" Muliarchuk[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Denis "Larl" Sigitov[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Magomed "Collapse" Khalilov[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Alexey "not_me" Kosmynin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Alexander "rue" Filin[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/55481652342_4378ab4bed_6k.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Until Next Time[/h3][p]If you missed any of the broadcast, or just want to rewatch some of the iconic plays, head over to the [url="https://www.youtube.com/user/dota2"]Dota 2 YouTube channel[/url], where you'll find replays of the entire show. You can also find a collection of photos from the event over on the [url="https://www.instagram.com/dota2/"]Dota 2 Instagram[/url] and even more hi-res shots on our [url="https://www.flickr.com/photos/dota2ti/"]Dota 2 flickr[/url].  As always, we'd like to thank all of the players, talent, and everyone in the Dota community for helping bring this global celebration to life. We've been honored to once again help shepherd this event to the stage, but it wouldn't be what it is without all of you.[/p]

newsitems.contents: [p]Here's your confirmed intel on how to pre-load the Open Beta right now, and the Weekend Two content waiting when the [i]Call of Duty[/i] Open Beta begins this Friday.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8f3ed1bc8b3cec670d4a28b25c18a180fe860ab7.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta: Getting Started[/h2][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta Schedule[/h3][list][*][p]All players can preload the Open Beta starting at 9:00 AM PT on Wednesday August 26.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weekend Two (Open Beta): August 28 at 10:00 AM PT – September 1 at 10:00 AM PT[/p][/*][/list][p]The Open Beta begins at 10:00 AM PT, Friday August 28 for players on Steam. The Open Beta is scheduled to end at 10:00 AM PT on Tuesday, September 1. [/p][p][/p][p]Here’s how to participate in the Open Beta:[/p][list][*][p]The Beta is available to all players. pre-order or Beta Codes are needed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]How to Access and Launch the Beta[/p][p]Steam (PC)[/p][list][*][p]Preload (Available Now): Beta to your Library and begin downloading.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Launch (Available at 10:00AM PT on Friday, August 28): Open your Steam Library and select [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] Beta when the Beta goes live.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Beta Rewards[/h3][p]Progress through the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta, rank up, and unlock cosmetic rewards along the way.[/p][list][*][p]Weekend Two: Start from Player Level 1, or return return to continue progressing from Weekend One, up to Level 30, unlocking all eight Beta Rewards, including the "Dread Tiger" Operator Skin for Reece, and the "Beta Forged" Weapon Blueprint for the Han 86 Assault Rifle.[/p][/*][/list][p]These rewards can only be earned during the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta and will be available in the full game at launch for players who unlock them.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f6c142460010825ef0043498d35704318789ae77.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Beta Rewards[/b][/p][list][*][p]Player Level 4: "Through the Paces" Legendary Emblem[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Player Level 8: "First Served" Weapon Charm[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Player Level 12: Forged" Weapon Blueprint – Han 86[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Additional Rewards[/b][/p][p]There's even more to unlock throughout the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta. Keep an eye out for additional cosmetic rewards earned through a variety of activities, including:[/p][list][*][p]Default Items (immediately available): 3 Emblems, 3 Calling Cards, 1 Spray, and 3 Loading Screens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mobility Course Challenge Reward: Clockwork Charm.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Combat Record Rewards: \[CLASSIFIED] Weapon Blueprint, Emblem, and Charm.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]\[CLASSIFIED] Challenge Reward: \[CLASSIFIED].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Twitch Drops[/b][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta Twitch Drops[/p][p]These rewards are available for watching your favorite creator throughout the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta.[/p][list][*][p]"Get Tactical" Emblem (for watching 15 minutes)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]"Clearing House" Calling Card (for watching 30 minutes)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]"Action Ready" Charm (for watching 45 minutes)[/p][/*][/list][p]For [url="https://support.activision.com/articles/managing-your-activision-profile"]further details on linking your Twitch account, click here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Patch Notes Access[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b] [i]Stay up to date throughout the Modern Warfare 4 Beta with the latest Patch Notes from the Infinity Ward Comms team.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/07f9045a3dc6a3814608a244e94506de76e5164a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Expect updates throughout the Beta covering everything from bug fixes and gameplay adjustments to new maps and modes. Visit the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Patch Notes for the latest intel.[/p][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4: Open Beta (Weekend Two) Content Intel[/h3][p]Everything below is available the Open Beta, giving you an early look at the Multiplayer, Campaign, and gameplay systems featured in the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]. [/p][p]Looking for a deeper dive? Check out the [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/08/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-open-beta-everything-you-need-to-know"]Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta: Everything You Need to Know blog[/url], featuring comprehensive breakdowns of every map, mode, weapon, gameplay system, progression unlock, and more.[/p][p][/p][h3]Campaign Mission: “Entrenched”[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b] [i]For the first time in a Call of Duty Beta, play a Campaign mission.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Join a large-scale assault to prevent the destruction of a vital nuclear power station.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Continue the fight with Campaign Early Access starting October 16 for digital pre-orders, ahead of the full game launch on October 23.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6b1a9f604122eba7271cfa581ec15c363c8210e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For the first time in Call of Duty Beta history, deploy into a complete Campaign mission before launch. In “Entrenched,” fight alongside friendly infantry and armored vehicles as you battle to prevent a strategically vital nuclear power station from falling into enemy hands.[/p][p][/p][h3]Mobility Course[/h3][p]Flex your expertise in mobility and make your way through the course as fast as possible.[/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Enter a dedicated training facility built to teach Modern Warfare 4's expanded movement and combat systems.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Learn every new maneuver through guided Tutorials before putting your skills to the test in timed Courses.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Return throughout the Beta to improve your ratings, refine your movement, weapon handling, and marksmanship, and build confidence before your next Multiplayer match.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/acc6d9c14a577053a6fa768b35f2e31ff24a6713.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Whether you're a new recruit or a returning veteran, the Mobility Course is your proving ground for [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]'s expanded movement and combat systems. Master new traversal techniques, sharpen your gunplay, chase faster completion times, and revisit the Courses whenever you want to fine-tune your skills between Multiplayer matches.[/p][p][/p][h3]Player Progression (Multiplayer)[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Earn XP in Multiplayer matches to increase your Player Level and unlock new gameplay content.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b][i]Open Beta:[/i][/b][i] Progress from Levels 1-30, unlocking new weapons, Equipment, Perks, Field Upgrades, Killstreaks, and eight Beta Rewards.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Beta Rewards earned during the Open Beta carry over to the full game at launch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1109307ef7f16d8f9602b8de3a2ef9b313b50108.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every Multiplayer match brings you closer to your next player level and new unlock. Climb through the ranks to expand your arsenal, customize your loadouts, and unlock Create a Class at Level 4. Continue earning XP to complete your progression and unlock even more weapons, Equipment, Perks, and Beta Rewards.[/p][p][/p][h3]Create a Class and Operators[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Build up to 12 Custom Loadouts, each with its own Operator, Weapons, Equipment, Perks, Field Upgrade, and Killstreaks.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Operators are now assigned on a per-loadout basis, giving every Custom Loadout its own identity.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Choose from 21 Operators during the Beta, including military specialists, iconic characters, and additional Operators available with the Vault Edition.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Unlock Create a Class at Player Level 4 and expand your customization options as you progress.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/da996c940de791da23e484ffbb40ce8802732c84.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] streamlines Create a Class by bringing every major loadout choice together into a single menu, making it faster than ever to build specialized loadouts for every combat role. Pair a unique Operator with each Custom Loadout, customize your weapons, Equipment, Perks, Field Upgrade, and Killstreaks, then fine-tune your setup before every deployment.[/p][p]Operators are now fully integrated into Create a Class, allowing each loadout to feature its own distinctive look, voice, and interchangeable Finishing Move. The Beta includes 21 Operators to choose from, including Operators available through the Vault Edition, with more arriving at launch.[/p][p][/p][h3]Weapons, Gunsmith, Apex Attachments, Gunny, and Firing Range[/h3][p]QUICK INTEL:[/p][list][*][p][i]Deploy with 19 weapons spanning nine weapon classes, with three additional weapons becoming available through Campaign or Default Loadouts.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Customize your arsenal using the returning Gunsmith, then test every build in the Firing Range before deployment.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Unlock powerful Apex Attachments by fully leveling supported weapons, adding unique gameplay effects without using an attachment slot.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Need a starting point? Gunny can instantly recommend a wide variety of Weapon builds using Attachments you've already unlocked.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Additional Weapons arrive with the full game at launch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9aabf73dc4db41e5e23f41c096a7e0f973afdeb8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Beta features 19 Multiplayer weapons spanning nine weapon classes. Three additional weapons are accessible through specific Default Loadouts or the Campaign mission, bringing the total number of weapons available across the Beta to 22. Customize supported weapons with Gunsmith, unlock game-changing Apex Attachments by mastering supported weapons, use Gunny to recommend optimized builds, and put every setup through its paces in the Firing Range.[/p][p][b]Note:[/b] Looking for the complete arsenal? Check out the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta: Everything You Need to Know blog with the full Beta weapon roster, Gunsmith and Apex Attachment breakdowns, Gunny tips, and complete weapon intel.[/p][p][/p][h3]Equipment: Tacticals, Lethals, Field Upgrades[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Build every loadout with 9 Tactical Equipment items, 11 Lethals, and 11 Field Upgrades, including [b]new equipment in every category.[/b][/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Gather intelligence, breach defended positions, deny enemy movement, defend objectives, and support your squad with equipment tailored to every combat role.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Additional equipment arrives with the full game at launch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/797ecfefb65c96977aa10876dee37065b3635755.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every loadout is more than just your Primary and Secondary weapons. Choose Tactical Equipment to gather intel, disrupt enemy movement, or recover in the heat of battle; Lethal Equipment to clear defenders, deny routes, and secure eliminations; and rechargeable Field Upgrades to support your squad, defend objectives, and create new tactical opportunities. [/p][p][/p][h3]Killstreaks[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Equip up to three Killstreaks to every Custom Loadout before deploying into Multiplayer.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Earn Killstreaks by achieving consecutive eliminations without being eliminated.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]The Beta features 17 Killstreaks.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Additional Killstreaks arrive when Modern Warfare 4 launches.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/381f5017db513dd78139b617122fdfe027332ef4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]From reconnaissance and support to devastating offensive firepower, Killstreaks are powerful combat rewards earned through aggressive play and survival. Choose from new and returning Killstreaks to build your preferred combination for each Custom Loadout, then progress throughout the Beta to unlock additional options as the Player Level cap increases to 30.[/p][p][/p][h3]Perks[/h3][p]QUICK INTEL:[/p][list][*][p][i]Customize your Operator with the Pick 3 Perk System, equipping one Perk from each of three Perk slots.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Choose from 18 Perks during the Beta.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Mix and match Perks to support aggressive assaults, stealth, survivability, mobility, objective play, and tactical awareness.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Additional Perks arrive when Modern Warfare 4 launches.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Perks are passive abilities that define how your Operator performs in combat. [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]'s Pick 3 system enables you to build combinations that complement your preferred weapons, Equipment, and overall playstyle, whether you're leading the charge, staying off enemy radar, or supporting your squad. [/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Deploy into seven Core 6v6 Multiplayer modes during the Open Beta.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Play Team Deathmatch, Domination, Hardpoint, Kill Confirmed, Search and Destroy, Inflation (new mode), and Hijack (new mode).[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]From classic objective modes to tactical one-life competition, every mode supports full Create a Class functionality.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Additional Multiplayer modes become available as the Beta continues, with more modes at launch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/231088053f7eca35c47b197b3b57a0db17d79a89.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Open Beta brings together Call of Duty's signature Multiplayer experiences with an all-new way to play. Alongside Team Deathmatch, Domination, Hardpoint, Kill Confirmed, and Search and Destroy, jump into Inflation, where every elimination builds your fortune while turning you into an increasingly valuable target. Also check out Hijack, where you carry, throw, or carry a Data Spike towards the enemy Comm Station, planting it to score while defenders race to defuse it. Each mode rewards a different style of play, from coordinated objective control to tactical, one-life precision.[/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Core 6v6 Maps[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Deploy across six Core 6v6 maps, each offering its own layout, engagement ranges, and tactical opportunities.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fight across snow-covered rooftops, dense shopping districts, coastal villages, rail terminals, and an overgrown bus depot.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Learn every route, flank, and vantage point before additional maps become available later in the Beta.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]More Core Multiplayer maps arrive when Modern Warfare 4 launches.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Every [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta map delivers a distinct combat experience:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd334fc7bca39e62973404044733589e4e598a0a.jpg"][/img][b]Rooftops:[/b] Traverse the snow-covered rooftops of New York's Hotel Times West using elevated walkways and multiple routes to outmaneuver the opposition.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/006957529cb43b330c26b30ce0ace43aa129a551.jpg"][/img][b]Silkworm:[/b] Push through a dense South Korean shopping district where storefronts, alleyways, and apartments keep engagements fast and unpredictable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/990295c75b98a711ed9bbc49fb2986f4ab155fb5.jpg"][/img][b]Transit 213:[/b] Navigate an overgrown Indian bus depot divided by rusting buses, concealed routes, and long sightlines.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/711b2c4a159f65fc26d647e1ca26b16d3db24160.jpg"][/img][b]Cachette:[/b] Fight through a secret hideout next to a French rail terminal packed with shipping containers, rooftops, and compact interiors built for constant flanking.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e0f7934492e0d5c2468bb0087a3c21567df5da21.jpg"][/img][b]Lotus:[/b] Deploy into a battle-scarred Korean fishing village where narrow streets, burning buildings, and abandoned armor create varied engagements from close quarters to long sightlines.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6f06439d7c40331b71e2a91cdf53f206a15288c8.jpg"][/img][b]Lithium:[/b] Fight across a damaged lithium processing facility in rural Mexico, where industrial buildings, processing equipment, interactive doors, and strong mid-range sightlines support a wide variety of combat styles.[/p][p][/p][h3]Kill Block and Gunfight[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Fight across Kill Block, a dynamic combat space that reconfigures every two rounds into a new Combo of three interconnected Slabs.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Experience Gunfight in both classic 3v3 and the 10v10 variant, exclusive to Kill Block.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Every map Combo introduces a new randomized shared Loadout, keeping every round fresh.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Eliminate the opposing team or capture the Overtime Flag to secure victory.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3035cf383c4720427652e9208ab867a45d808a5a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Kill Block reimagines Gunfight with an ever-changing combat space built from interconnected Slabs. Every two rounds, a new Combo and randomized shared Loadout transform the flow of the match, demanding constant adaptation. Jump into the classic intensity of 3v3 Gunfight or the new 10v10 variant, where larger teams bring an entirely different dynamic—and considerably more mayhem—to Kill Block's evolving arenas.[/p][p][/p][h3]Ground War Multiplayer Maps (24v24, Beta)[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Battle across two large-scale Combat Outpost battlegrounds set within the Haijin region.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Fight between open countryside and dense urban terrain with infantry and vehicle combat across both maps.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Both maps offer unique routes, landmarks, and tactical opportunities.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Combat Outpost spans two distinct large-scale theaters of conflict, each offering a different approach to Ground War combat. Whether crossing open farmland or fighting through dense urban streets, learning the terrain, major landmarks, and key routes is essential to supporting your team and maintaining control of the match.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/de000d116d85e2d26922844594ee4a2eba040538.jpg"][/img]Battle across the rural outskirts of Haijin, where open fields, waterways, scattered farms, and the large-scale mill combine with roads and rail lines to create a combat zone suited to long sightlines, vehicle maneuvering, and coordinated assaults on key strongholds.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd8e10fb8549b36c1115ba8882778d3acd22f6ac.jpg"][/img]Fight through the heart of Haijin in a dense urban environment centered on the Wolves Stadium. Multi-story buildings, transit lines, tunnels, rooftops, and surrounding hillsides create a highly versatile arena of battle where every route offers multiple ways to advance.[/p][p][/p][h3]Call of Duty: Warzone Resurgence[/h3][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Experience Resurgence on the all-new Zodiac map.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Battle across the DRC Advanced Systems drone assembly headquarters.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Stay alive while your teammates redeploy, then eliminate enemies and complete Contracts to shorten their return timer.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Outlast every opposing squad to secure the win.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1665ed163616d40761d6efa3a75821cfa3a74b04.jpg"][/img]Resurgence returns with the all-new Zodiac, a compact combat zone built around the DRC Advanced Systems drone assembly and manufacturing headquarters. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c53c46a7fec33520fea9b6d89f2692f528e349b5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight from the company Admin building through and beneath the central double Trackline with multiple trains, then push toward the R&D facility and shipping docks as squads battle across offices, manufacturing buildings, rooftops, tunnels, and the surrounding shoreline. Expect an explosive tank battle, legendary loot, action across the ground and air, and other surprises to find during your matches.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/748b7174fb26a06bab7d0f69e83162660af3ab9a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every Loadout has room to dominate and are default for the Beta. Choose from AR, SMG, LMG, or Sniper Default Loadouts. Close-range Operators can weave between buildings and through the center of the facility, while longer-range Loadouts benefit from rooftops and elevated windows overlooking the facility’s points of interest. Beneath it all, an underground tunnel network offers another way to rotate, flank enemy squads, or briefly disappear before launching your next attack.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay frosty: We'll see you in the Beta.[/p][p][/p][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on Steam on Friday, October 23, 2026. [/p][p][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: The International Main Event
newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/a7ab9b6d4c788583a689e0519021a93a76c17f30.png"][/img][/p][p]The sixteen best Dota teams in the world spent the last week battling through an intense Group Stage, and now only eight contenders remain. In a matter of hours Team Vision, Team Liquid, Nigma Galaxy, Team Falcons, BoomBoys, Team Spirit, Iron Wing, and Team Yandex will begin the final push to claim the Aegis of Champions as they all fight to be the last team standing at The International 2026.[/p][p]The double elimination bracket that will crown our champions kicks off at SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center in Shanghai on Thursday, August 20 and will culminate in a best-of-five Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23. We congratulate everyone who has made it this far, and we eagerly await the final test.[/p][p][/p][h2]Attending The International[/h2][p]If you're heading to the arena in Shanghai to watch The International live, a flurry of activity awaits you. Check out some of the more important details below.[/p][p][/p][h3]Schedule [/h3][p]The International pre-show begins each day at 9:30 AM China Standard Time. Things officially kick off with the Opening Ceremony at 10 AM on Thursday, and the first series is scheduled to start soon after. On the following days, matches will begin at 10 AM. Take in the [url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]full schedule of matches available here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]Meet the Teams[/h3][p]Each day of the Main Event, fans will have the chance to attend meet and greets with teams and talent on the 2F Concourse of the arena. Fan participation will be determined by a random draw of eligible ticket holders who have purchased tickets prior to 5 PM the day before. Selected fans will be notified electronically — as well as on TV displays throughout the venue concourse. More information on slots and eligibility will be provided on site.[/p][p][/p][h3]Crimson Witness and Badge Binding[/h3][p]Attendees should pick up their commemorative badges and event swag bags when they scan a digital ticket for their first entry into the venue. Remember to bind your badge to your Steam account to ensure you're eligible for Crimson Witness Treasure drops on the First Blood of each game at The International.[/p][p][/p][h3]Venue Information[/h3][p]To help things run smoothly, here's a rundown of some venue details you should know:[/p][list][*][p][b]What time do doors open? [/b]Arena doors open every day at 8 AM China Standard Time, two hours before the first match. Please note that entry will not be allowed after 9 PM each evening.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Where should I enter the arena?[/b] [url="https://cdn.steamstatic.com/apps/dota2/images/dota_react//international2026/map.png"]Please queue for entrance at the arena's Gate 0 Plaza[/url]. Those with 1F Stands and Suites tickets, please queue at the left-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. Those with 3F Stands tickets, please queue at the right-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. After passing through the turnstile for ticket verification, please collect your swag bag.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Can I sit anywhere or are there preassigned seats?[/b] Seats at The International 2026 are assigned. Please make sure to queue in the entry area designated outside of the arena for your seating sections.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Is re-entry permitted?[/b] All ticket holders are permitted to enter and exit the venue up to THREE times per match day. For re-entry, please re-queue in the designated lane.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The On-Site Secret Shop[/h3][p]The Secret Shop will operate in SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center from August 20 - 23, opening each day at 9:00am and closing after the first break of the last series of the day. Customers are welcome to purchase directly from on-site cashiers or use the Perfect World app to place an order for pick-up.[/p][p][/p][h3]On-Site Activities[/h3][p]In addition to SecretLab and SteelSeries booths in the concourse, The International Players Jackets and Championship rings from all previous years will be on display. Plus, all fans are invited to leave their mark on the event by signing one of the graffiti walls. There will also be opportunities to take photos with cosplayers roaming the arena on Saturday and Sunday, and don't forget to check out the handmade embroidered Aegis of Champions on display throughout the event.[/p][p][/p][h3]Cosplay Finalists[/h3][p]Don't miss the best of this year's crop of Dota 2 cosplay, on display in the arena on August 23 before the Grand Finals.[/p][p][/p][h3]Watching The International Online[/h3][p]Even if you can't make it to the arena, there are still a ton of options to catch all the action at The International. From Twitch to YouTube to Steam, The International will be streamed on multiple platforms in multiple languages.[/p][list][*][p][b]Chinese[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]English[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Russian[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_RU"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Spanish[/b]: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es"]Twitch[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]Steam[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]YouTube[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/dota2"]Facebook[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The Online Secret Shop[/h3][p]Fans interested in purchasing swag from this year's offerings are welcome to purchase online. We have two shops available, depending on which part of the world you're in. Fans located in China can purchase through [url="https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/"]https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/[/url] and fans everywhere else can head over to [url="https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/"]https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/[/url] to check it all out.[/p]
